item.title: How to create a Twitter bot using R
item.description: Last week, I decided to kill an afternoon by creating a Twitter bot. Why? Mostly, I was procrastinating on revisions for a manuscript and looking for a small R project to practice my programming skills. Creating a Twitter bot seemed like a great option: Bots can follow other users, retweet content from others, or post original content, and all of this is basically controlled by a script(s).
